name: My Final Trial
source:
Private Illisible has been sent to trial 5 times for the murder of 8 year old  ▇▇▇ ▇▇▇▇. This trial is her last one, and will determine her final sentence.  A "guilty" verdict will have her sentenced to death. This doesn't seem to bother her.

[From [url=https://lavendroid.itch.io/myfinaltrial]itch.io[/url]]
